Conviva measures the Quality of Experience customers get from your AI agents and streaming apps, revealing what your tools miss and whether customers convert, come back, or leave.

Most unhappy customers never tell you, but they give you clues.

• Correcting the agent
• Repeating the request
• Finishing the task themselves

Traditional tools grade the response. They don't tell you if the customer on the other end had a good experience.

Corrected the agent
Repeated the request

The signals your evals can’t see.

Intent

Did the agent understand what the customer asked for, or answer a different question?

Sentiment

Did the experience get better or worse each time the customer had to correct or repeat themselves?

Outcome

Did the customer get what they came for in the chat, or have to finish it somewhere else?

Stop chasing better scores.
‍Start driving better experiences.

Drive conversion

See where the agent experience is hurting conversion, then fix what’s causing customers to abandon, spend less, or leave without buying.

Increase satisfaction and retention

Track sentiment shifts throughout every interaction to pinpoint where trust starts to waver and address the issue before it leads to dissatisfaction or churn.

Reduce cost

Lower the cost of every interaction by eliminating unnecessary work and using lower-cost models where they won’t compromise the customer experience.

FROM STREAMING QOE TO AGENT QOE

We’ve seen this before.

Conviva pioneered Quality of Experience analytics for streaming by showing the industry that technical performance alone couldn't explain what viewers experienced. Today, we're applying that same lesson to AI agents.

Buffering
Bitrate drops

Patents

In experience intelligence

The Conviva Quality of Experience Platform

One platform for Quality of Experience, from AI agents to streaming.
Built for real-time, production-scale experience analytics.

Agent Experience Insights

Agent analytics for what happens during and after every interaction. Connect intent, sentiment, and outcome to find where the experience breaks down and why.

Streaming Experience Insights

See Quality of Experience across video, ads, and apps on a unified timeline to understand what’s driving engagement and get to the root cause before it costs you viewers.
